item.title: GTA VI shows what PS5/Series X can really do. Has this gen been held back by priorities, not diminishing returns?
item.author: invalid@example.com (the_marmolade)
item.dc:creator: the_marmolade
item.content:encoded: I'm partway through GTA VI, and one thing keeps hitting me: this is the first game that genuinely feels like a generational leap on current hardware. In past generations we'd usually have seen something like this within the first couple of years of a console's life. This time it took until year six.
